    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    shapes = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        stack.append((yy, xx))
            r0 = min(y for y, x in cells); r1 = max(y for y, x in cells)
            c0 = min(x for y, x in cells); c1 = max(x for y, x in cells)
            shape = [[grid[y][x] if (y,x) in set(cells) else 0 for x in range(c0,c1+1)] for y in range(r0,r1+1)]
            shapes.append((color, shape))
    shapes.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    out = []
